Confluence has no footnote of its own1, so mark builds one out of the anchor macro2.

A note may be cited more than once1, and each citation gets its own way back.

A note may carry markup3 of its own.

  1. The marketplace has footnote plugins; the bundled macros do not include one. ↩︎ ↩︎

  2. Bundled with Data Center and Cloud alike, so nothing has to be installed. ↩︎

  3. A note can hold bold text and a link. ↩︎
